cases.rationale: Prospective full-reference same-composition polymorph case. Coexisting scheelite/stolzite and raspite PbWO4 are paired with residual massicot PbO and compensating WO3, preserving the robotically dosed Pb:W = 1:1 ratio. Both PbWO4 frameworks are published and remain available. The case tests whether overlapping polymorphs are separated and retained through a four-phase heavy-atom refinement rather than collapsed into one formula match.
